newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKEY PLANS TO LOWER PROPERTY TAX RATES.
newsitem.headline: TURKEY PLANS TO LOWER PROPERTY TAX RATES.

text.p: Turkey is planning to raise more property tax revenue by changing the present system, Finance Minister Abdullatif Sener said on Wednesday.
"Tax rates will be lowered and taxable value will be the market value," Sener told a meeting in Ankara.
A senior ministry official said property tax rates would fall to 0.2 percent from current 0.3 percent for land to 0.3 percent from 0.4 percent for houses and flats under the draft law.
The draft which is still under study at the ministry, also envisages to lower the surcharge on real estate purchase and sales.
The value of taxable properties will be revalued every year in line with the official revaluation rate, announced by the ministry.
Sener said real estate owners declared the value of their properties lower than their market values under the present system.
Officials say the change is expected to increase revenues from real estate taxes.
